name: Code Block
description: A code block with a language label and one-click copy button.

name: Comparison Table
description: A feature-by-plan comparison matrix with checkmarks.

name: Data Table
description: A tidy data table for structured comparisons and results.

name: File Diff
description: An inline diff card showing the additions and deletions the agent proposes.

name: Inline Citations
description: Superscript citation markers with a compact source footer.

name: Message Actions
description: The action row under an assistant message: good response, bad response, copy, an emoji reaction, reply, and more.

name: Orbs
description: Compact animated activity indicators for agent UIs - discrete DOM and CSS orbs that signal what the agent is doing without blocking the thread.

name: Reasoning Effort
description: A stepped control for how much reasoning a model spends. Low keeps the budget short, Extra High uses the full thinking budget. While you drag, the model and the active level merge out of the track, then fold back on release.

name: Secure Input
description: A card the agent sends in chat when it needs a secret for the screen it is driving. The value is handed to that screen, not typed into the thread.

name: Streaming Text
description: Typewriter-style streaming text with a blinking caret.

name: Text Response
description: Clean prose styling for a standard assistant answer with inline code.

name: Thinking + Reasoning
description: An animated, collapsible thinking block: a shimmering label expands to reveal the agent's reasoning, then folds into a “Thought for Ns” summary.

name: Thinking State
description: A minimal shimmering label that signals the agent is processing before it answers.
